title: Correct fall time
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the time to reach the ground as 3 seconds, using the appropriate kinematic equation.

title: Correct impact velocity
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the magnitude of the velocity upon impact as 30 m/s.

title: Correct last-second distance
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the distance fallen in the last second as 25 meters.

title: Applies kinematic equations
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply constant-acceleration kinematic equations (e.g., s = ut + ½at², v = u + at) for free fall from rest.

title: Strategy for part (3)
description: Important: For the last-second distance, the solution must find the distance fallen in the total time minus the distance fallen in the time preceding the last second.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculated quantities should be presented with correct units (s, m/s, m).

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect sign for gravitational acceleration (e.g., using +10 m/s² for downward motion) in the equations.

title: Misinterprets last-second distance
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculating the last-second distance (e.g., using the formula for distance in the nth second without adjustment, or using the total distance as the answer).
